==Description==
'''Northern Lights''' is an easy map made by Your_Adversary. It a night-time map set in a small village.

==Design & Path==
'''Northern Lights''' is a small village positioned on the side of a frozen sea. It is set during the night-time and an aurora borealis can be seen in the sky. The village consists of a few wooden cottages. Multiple trees can be seen all around the map.

The path starts at a few totems with neon blue symbols on them and ends at an orange portal. It takes multiple short straights and enters two different loops.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Northern Lights}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*Towers should generally be placed around the middle, as for towers with higher range this will allow them to cover the most of the path.
**Due to the compact layout of the path, very high range towers like the [[Ranger]] can easily cover it all.
*This map contains two separate loops which can be pretty good spots for low range towers like the [[Brawler]], [[Slasher]] or [[Shotgunner]].
*The layout of the map contains many spots where the [[Ace Pilot]]'s main circle path covers a portion of the path majority of the time, making this map a decent choice for it.
